title: Clean binary search implementation with boundary validation
diff:
@@ -3,4 +3,15 @@
 T = TypeVar("T")
 
 def binary_search(elements: Sequence[T], target: T) -> Optional[int]:
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    """Find index of target in sorted sequence, or None if not found."""
+    low, high = 0, len(elements) - 1
+    while low <= high:
+        mid = low + (high - low) // 2
+        val = elements[mid]
+        if val == target:
+            return mid
+        elif val < target:
+            low = mid + 1
+        else:
+            high = mid - 1
+    return None
